title: Stir Fried Rice
description: A simple and flavorful Asian-inspired dish made with stir fried rice, vegetables, and your choice of protein.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent.
Add the grated carrots and sliced bell pepper, cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the thawed peas and stir-fry for 1-2 minutes.
Add the cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice with the vegetables for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the stir-fried rice to a serving platter or individual plates.
